== Clarification ==
If you fail an [[Evade check]], you are also [[lost in time and space]].

==Mythos Source==

A Dimensional Shambler appears in the story ''The Horror in the Museum'' (1932), ghost-written by H.P. Lovecraft for Hazel Heald.
